metrics.definition: The numbers on this page count requests created in the selected period. A request created earlier and resolved in this period belongs to the period of its creation. There is one exception: "Finished in the period" counts requests resolved or closed in the period, whenever they were created.
metrics.capped: Response time, resolution time and lines are computed on the first {count} requests of the period: there are more. Narrow the period to count them all.

overview.slaHint: SLA compliance: the share of requests without a breach mark among those whose outcome is already known. First response: answered or the deadline has passed. Resolution: resolved or the deadline has passed; requests waiting for the client and merged duplicates are not counted.
overview.timeHint: Time is counted in working hours of the SLA calendar. Time to resolution excludes waiting for the client.

channels.title: Channels: portal, widget, email
channels.hint: The widget combines Smartup Web and the mobile app. Requests created by staff are shown separately so that shares add up to 100%.

lines.title: Support lines
lines.returns: Returns from the second line to the first: {count}
lines.hint: Resolved requests of the period are counted. A request is resolved on the line where it was right before it became "Resolved": the status "In development" means development, the first line queue means the first line, the second line and Customer Care queues mean the second line. Time on a line: working hours from creation to resolution, including waiting for the client; the average is over the requests that were on the line. The line is rebuilt from the request history, so a move made by an automation rule is counted too.

breakdown.hint: Rows are sorted by the number of created requests. Deadlines are counted the same way as in the overview.

request.intro: If your address is confirmed in Smartup Hub, we will send a sign-in link to it.
request.sent: If the address is confirmed in Smartup Hub, we have sent a sign-in link to it. The link works for 15 minutes.

page.title: Sign in to Smartup Hub
page.text: Press the button to sign in.
page.invalid: This link no longer works. A sign-in link works once and for 15 minutes.

confirmEmail.title: Confirm your address
confirmEmail.text: Press the button to confirm the address for sign-in links.
confirmEmail.done: Address confirmed. You can now sign in to Smartup Hub with a link sent to this email.
confirmEmail.invalid: This link no longer works. Request a new one in your profile.
confirmEmail.taken: This address is already linked to another account. Enter a different address in your profile.
confirmEmail.signInRequired: To confirm the address, sign in to the portal in this browser with the account where you entered it, then open the link again.
confirmEmail.wrongAccount: This link was issued for another account. Sign in with the account where you entered the address, or delete the email if you did not enter it.
confirmEmail.account: The address will be linked to the account {name}.

welcome.title: Hello, {name}
welcome.text: Enter your email. We will send a confirmation link, and then you can sign in to the portal with a link sent to your inbox.
welcome.sent: We have sent an email. Open it and press "Confirm address".

errors.rateLimited: Too many requests. Try again in an hour.
errors.stale: To set your sign-in email, you need a sign-in within the last 15 minutes. Sign in again and repeat.

welcome.policyLine: How the portal handles your data is described in the <link>Data processing policy</link>.
welcome.policyTitle: The data processing policy was updated
welcome.policyText: Read the new version: <link>Data processing policy</link>.

invite.title: Invitation to {orgName}
invite.text: Invitation for {email}. Accept it to work with the organization in Smartup Hub.
invite.name: Your name
invite.invalid: This invitation no longer works. Ask your company administrator to send a new one.
invite.taken: This address cannot be used for an invitation. Ask for an invitation to a different address.
invite.existingAccount: This address already has an account: sign in to it to accept the invitation.
invite.signInRequired: Sign in with the account for {email} and open the link again: the invitation will wait.
invite.wrongAccount: You are signed in as {name}, but the invitation is for {email}. Sign out and accept the invitation again.
invite.signOut: Sign out and return to the invitation

telegram.title: Sign in to Smartup Hub
telegram.text: Press the button to sign in.
telegram.invalid: This link no longer works. A link from the bot works once and for 10 minutes. Request a new one in the bot.

auth.tooOften: Too many attempts from your address. Wait 10 minutes and press the button again.

loginLink.subject: Sign in to Smartup Hub
loginLink.text:
Hello,

To sign in to Smartup Hub, open the link and press "Sign in":
{url}

The link works for {minutes} minutes and only once. If you did not ask to sign in, just delete this email.

confirmEmail.subject: Confirm your address for Smartup Hub
confirmEmail.text:
Hello,

To sign in to Smartup Hub with a link sent to this address, open the link and press "Confirm address":
{url}

The link works for {minutes} minutes. If you did not enter this address, just delete this email: an unconfirmed address is not linked to anything.

invitation.subject: Invitation to Smartup Hub
invitation.text:
Hello,

{inviterName} invites you to the organization {orgName} in Smartup Hub, the Smartup support portal.

To accept the invitation, open the link and press "Accept":
{url}

The invitation is valid for {days} days.

telegramLinked.subject: Telegram is linked to Smartup Hub
telegramLinked.text:
Hello,

The Telegram account {account} is now linked to your Smartup Hub account. It can be used to sign in to the portal.

If this was not you, unlink it in your profile:
{url}

staffInvitation.subject: Invitation to the Smartup Hub workspace
staffInvitation.text:
Hello!

{inviterName} invites you to the workspace of Smartup Hub, the Smartup support portal.

Open the link, set a password and connect the second sign-in factor:
{url}

The link works for {hours} hours and only once. Do not forward it to anyone.

staffReset.subject: Your Smartup Hub access was reset
staffReset.text:
Hello!

The portal administrator reset your password and second sign-in factor in Smartup Hub. All your sessions have been ended.

Open the link, set a new password and connect the second factor again:
{url}

The link works for {hours} hours and only once. If you did not ask for a reset, tell the administrator.

layout.replyAbove: Reply to this email and your reply will be added to the request

ticketCreated.heading: Request SUP-{number} created
ticketCreated.text: We have received your request "{title}". You will get the answer by email and in the portal.
ticketCreated.viaEmail: We have received your email "{title}" and created request SUP-{number}. To add details, reply to this email.

ticketStatus.heading: News on request SUP-{number}
ticketStatus.waiting_customer: We are waiting for your reply on request SUP-{number} "{title}". Reply to this email or in the portal.
ticketStatus.in_development: Request SUP-{number} "{title}" has been passed to development. We will write when there is news.
ticketStatus.closed: Request SUP-{number} "{title}" is closed. If the question remains, write to us.
ticketStatus.autoClosed: Request SUP-{number} "{title}" is closed because we did not get a reply. If the question remains, write to us.
ticketStatus.merged: Request SUP-{number} has been merged with request SUP-{into}. The conversation continues there.
ticketStatus.rate: Rate how we helped (1 poor, 5 excellent):

ticketResolved.heading: Request SUP-{number} resolved
ticketResolved.text: We consider the question "{title}" resolved. Please rate the answer: it takes a minute. If something is wrong, reply to this email.

waitingReminder.heading: Waiting for your reply
waitingReminder.text: We are waiting for your reply on request SUP-{number} "{title}". Without a reply the request will be closed in {days, plural, one {# working day} other {# working days}}.

unidentifiedAck.subject: Your email has been received
unidentifiedAck.heading: Your email has been received
unidentifiedAck.text: We have received your email. Request number: SUP-{number}. A support specialist will answer you by email.

staffMention.heading: You were mentioned in a note
staffMention.text: {author} mentions you in a note on request SUP-{number} "{title}".

staffBreach.heading: Deadline missed
staffBreach.first_response: The first response deadline for request SUP-{number} "{title}" has been missed.
staffBreach.resolution: The resolution deadline for request SUP-{number} "{title}" has been missed.

staffUpdateDue.heading: Time to update the client
staffUpdateDue.text: Tomorrow the regular update deadline expires for request SUP-{number} "{title}" in development. Write to the client what is known today.

holidaysReminder.subject: Holidays for {year}
holidaysReminder.text: The list of holidays for {year} is empty. Without it holidays count as working days when deadlines are calculated.

oncallP1.subject: Urgent P1 request
oncallP1.text: New urgent P1 request from {orgName}: SUP-{number}.

inboundTest.subject: Smartup Hub mail intake check {token}
inboundTest.text: This is a check email from the Smartup Hub portal. If it has reached the portal, mail intake for {address} works. There is no need to reply.

staffDevTaskClosed.heading: Development task closed
staffDevTaskClosed.text: Development task {ref} is closed: check and tell the client. Request SUP-{number} "{title}" stays in development until you change its status.

staffCsatLow.heading: Low client rating
staffCsatLow.text: A client of {orgName} rated request SUP-{number} "{title}" with {score}. Open the request: the reason for the rating is on its page.

ideaStatus.heading: News on idea {ref}
ideaStatus.published: Your idea {ref} “{title}” passed review and is published. Clients of all organizations can vote for it now.
ideaStatus.declined: Idea {ref} “{title}” was declined. Details are on the idea page.
ideaStatus.merged: Idea {ref} “{title}” was merged into the similar idea {into}: the votes were moved there.
ideaStatus.shortlisted: Idea {ref} “{title}” made the idea of the month shortlist.
ideaStatus.selected: Idea {ref} “{title}” was selected as the idea of the month.
ideaStatus.comment_hidden: A moderator hid your comment on idea {ref} “{title}”. The reason is on the idea page.

staffIdeaModeration.subject: Ideas waiting for review: {count}
staffIdeaModeration.text: Ideas in review for over two working days: {count}. Publish, decline or merge them.

staffIdeaCycle.subject: The idea of the month shortlist is ready
staffIdeaCycle.text: Ideas in the shortlist: {count}. Choose the idea of the month.

staffIdeaDevTaskClosed.text: Development task {ref} is closed: check it and, once released, set idea {idea} “{title}” to Released.

bot.linked: Done: Telegram is linked to the account {name} in the organization {org}. You can sign in to Smartup Hub here when Smartup is not available. If you did not link it, press "Unlink".
bot.alreadyLinked: This Telegram account is already linked to another Smartup Hub account. Unlink it there first.
bot.codeInvalid: The link no longer works. Open your profile in Smartup Hub and press "Link Telegram" again.
bot.unlinked: Telegram is unlinked from the account. You can link it again in your Smartup Hub profile.
bot.notLinked: This Telegram account is not linked to a Smartup Hub account. You can link it in your profile on the portal.
bot.fallback: I help you sign in to Smartup Hub and link Telegram. Please ask questions and report problems on the portal.
bot.loginLink: Your sign-in link for Smartup Hub. It works for {minutes} min and only once. Do not forward it to anyone.
bot.loginTooOften: Too many sign-in links. Try again in {minutes} min.
bot.loginNoAccess: This account has no access to the portal right now. Contact your company administrator.
bot.oncallTest: Smartup Hub test message: the on-call chat is connected, urgent request alerts will arrive here.

notify.waiting_customer: We are waiting for your reply.
notify.in_development: Passed to development. We will write when there is news.
notify.autoClosed: The request is closed: we did not get a reply.
notify.merged: Merged into SUP-{into}. The conversation continues there.
notify.resolved: The request is resolved. Rate the answer or reopen the request.
notify.reminder: We are waiting for your reply. Without a reply the request will be closed in {days, plural, one {# working day} other {# working days}}.

ops.jobs_failed: Smartup Hub: background jobs that failed in the last hour: {count}. Check the worker log.
ops.outbox_failed: Smartup Hub: emails and messages not sent in the last hour: {count}. Check the outbox.
ops.outbox_lag: Smartup Hub: the outbox has been stuck for {minutes} min, waiting to be sent: {count}.
ops.inbound_stuck: Smartup Hub: incoming emails not processed for more than 10 minutes: {count}.
ops.staff_signin_failures: Smartup Hub: failed staff sign-ins in 15 minutes: {count}. Someone may be guessing a password.
ops.infected_files: Smartup Hub: infected files found in the last hour: {count}.
ops.archive_failing: Smartup Hub: the database log archive is not being saved, failed attempts: {count}. Check the archive directory and disk space.
ops.inbound_held: Smartup Hub: the rate limit stopped {count} inbound emails within an hour. They were not added to requests: too many emails from one address or to one request.
ops.unidentified_flood: Smartup Hub: {count} requests were created from emails from unknown addresses within an hour. A flood is possible. Check "Unidentified" and the mail settings.
ops.automation_dropped: Smartup Hub: {count} automation events were not processed within an hour. Their rules and notifications did not run, an on-call message about a P1 request may be among them. Check the background process log.
ops.automation_lag: Smartup Hub: automation events have not been processed for {minutes} min, waiting: {count}. Rules and notifications are late, an on-call message about a P1 request may be among them. Check the background process log.
ops.builtin_rule_inactive: Smartup Hub: built-in notifications are not working, rules: {count} ({rules}). A rule is turned off or broken: on-call messages about P1, notices to the lead about a missed deadline or a low rating are not sent. Check the automation rules in settings.
ops.backup_stale: Smartup Hub: database backups are out of date ({kinds}), kinds: {count}. dump: no nightly backup for more than 26 hours, base: no base backup for more than 8 days, wal: the database log has not been archived for more than 26 hours. Check the backup scripts log on the server.

editor.intro: Developer page: a Tiptap trial before choosing the editor. The document is stored as a structure and shown with components.
editor.saved: The document is saved and checked against the schema.
editor.invalid: The document failed the schema check. Showing the sample.

toolbar.linkPrompt: Link address: https, mailto or a portal path. An empty address removes the link.

sample.step2: Check the item stock and post the document again.

loader.toastTitle: Something went wrong. Report it and I will look for a solution.
loader.portalTitle: Could not open the form here. Open it in the portal.

panel.refused: This page opens only from Smartup.

panel.unavailable: Support is not available right now. Try again later.

errors.description: Describe what you were doing before the error
